additions.title: Orman Harrington
additions.note: Middle-aged man who hired your party in Ashwood. He hired you to steal Alric's Locket

additions.title: Orman Harrington Request
additions.note: My brother passed several years ago. He was a crafter. He made jewelry. This is all I have left of his. This was stolen by an influential elf. A powerful mage I suspect. I would ask the guards for assistance but they do not help when it involves mages or the connected, also they would ask for proof it is mine and I have none. This mage, his name is Alric. I would not ask you to try to take it from him directly, I know that is beyond your abilities. No, I was unable to seek this item out until recently. It has come to my attention that he has gifted the item away, to someone of far less means. Someone I think that is within your abilities. Her name Gilda. I suspect his wife would not like to know about her.

additions.title: Alric Thorne
additions.note: Alric is slender, with sharp elven features. He dresses in elegant green and gold finery, embroidered with thorn motifs and adorned with tiny bells that chime softly with his movements. Soft leather boots rise to mid-calf, supple and well-made. A silver chain rests just beneath his collar, mostly hidden. He carries a slim cane—clearly decorative, but possibly more—and a silver ring set with a black opal gleams whenever it catches the light. He never seems to give a straight answer; often speaks in rhymes or riddles. Seems constantly amused.

additions.title: Virelle
additions.note: Alric's wife. Elven woman with silver eyes. Was last seen wearing a dark crimson cloak over black leather and a silver necklace of a wasp. Worshiper of Callistria

additions.title: Sylwen
additions.note: Alric and Virelle's friend. Virelle didn't seem to like her much. Sylwen is a striking elf with angular features and long silver hair that flows like a silken veil. Her lavender eyes glow faintly in low light, and her skin carries an ethereal, almost translucent quality. She is of average elven height, graceful and slender, last seen wearing a deep violet robe adorned with silver embroidery. Her movements are fluid, and she seems to always be poised.

additions.title: The Theft
additions.note: Stumpy pretended to lose his balance tripping into a waitress and pulled her blouse down and Olga spat her drink out over a flame in suprise to the sudden sight. Meanwhile, using the distraction, Lysander tried to lift the necklace. Lysander failed and ended up ripping it off her neck attracting the attention of the guards and a priestess. Lysander ran but not before getting a firebolt to his ass.

additions.title: The Locket
additions.note: Looking at the locket after escaping Lysander saw a middle aged elven looking man inside

additions.title: Reward
additions.note: Collecting their reward the party neglected to tell Orman about their partial failure. They were supposed to do it unnoticed

additions.title: Caught
additions.note: The party fled town and made it to a village several days away. They awoke the next day to three people in their room: Alric, Virelle, and Sylwen. Virelle demanded they be executed but Alric thought that was too dull and uninteresting of a punishment. He instead sent them to his sisters as he put it. Before being banished to the fey wilds Stumpy was given a bottle of ale that Alric never asked to be returned.

additions.title: Arrival in the Fey Wilds
additions.note: You suddenly find yourselves standing inside a vast chamber, the air thick with the scent of blooming flowers and the rich earthiness of moss. The walls are not walls at all but living, breathing plants—intertwining vines and creeping ivy wrap around the stone, their leaves pulsing faintly with light. Thick flowers of every color imaginable hang from the ceiling like chandeliers, their petals opening and closing in rhythm with some unseen, gentle breeze.

additions.title: Dala Nyssira
additions.note: Dala Nyssira is a fey noble who agreed to send the party back home in exchange for a few tasks. She is a tall, ethereal figure with pale, green-tinged skin and piercing golden amber eyes that occasionally shimmer with light. Her long, silvery hair flows in soft waves, interwoven with flowers and ivy that slowly moves and shifts on it’s own. She wears a gown made of living flowers, each blooming with insects flying around drinking the nectar. Her movements are graceful and silent, and her voice is musical, carrying both an enchanting and commanding presence.

additions.title: Dala's Request
additions.note: Intruders into my realm. How brave must you be to come here? I could simply send you back to the mundane, but what would be the fun in that? No, no. I have tasks that need to be done. I am bored and uninterested in such trivial things my playthings. You could do them though, I think five tasks wouldn’t take you too long, but then again time can get very stretchy out here. How many years has already passed I wonder

additions.title: First Task
additions.note: Frendamus is late in delivering Dala's slippers. The slippers were stolen and after some investigation a trail was followed to a warehouse owned by a Lark named Lydia. They find Lydia dancing uncontrolably in the corner. Finding the slippers they left her to her fate but not before helping themselves to some of her possessions.

additions.title: Reward
additions.note: Frendamus is greatly relieved you found the slippers and rewarded you with your choice of footware. She seems confused about any questions related to the purpose or abilities of her items. Olga notes some footwraps that she decides to keep. Crude at first glance—just heavy bands of leather and knotted cord—but each strap bears burn-scars, bite-marks, and dried blood. When bound tightly up the calves and feet, they flex and pulse with primal tension. The name Martha is burned into the inside of one of the straps.

additions.title: Strange Effects
additions.note: Olga's nose appears to grow a bit larger and Stumpy turns greenish. It is suspected that the fey food had this effect on them. Olga's sense of smell improves and Stumpy seems to need less food. These changes eventually go away after returning home

additions.title: Second Task
additions.note: Now. My feast draws near, and I grow bored of honeyed fruits and marrowless bones. I crave something wild. Bring me an emberboar. Alive. Chained, if you must, but breathing. I want its rage hot and thrashing when I slit its throat beneath the bloom moon.

additions.title: Wild Hunt Preperations
additions.note: The party located the Wild Hunt after a few weeks of waiting and gathering information. Deciding it would be reckless to show up without something to show they decide to hunt a bear. One is found and a trophy is made of it.

additions.title: Wild Hunt
additions.note: The path winds through twisted groves and bioluminescent thickets until the trees suddenly part, revealing a wide, slow-moving river gleaming beneath the wan light of a shifting Feywild moon. Mist surrounds the area, curling and dancing like living things. The scent of moss and wildflowers is thick in the air, mingled with the faint, metallic tang of old blood. Upon approaching they are given a riddle but are unable to solve it. Next it is requested the share a deed of valor which Stumpy does. Instead of challenging them to a duel, as is custom, the offering of the bear trophy sufficed.

additions.title: Harkon of the Hollow Antler, Master of the Tally
additions.note: Eladrin Undead Skeleton Mage. A gaunt, skeletal figure clad in bark-wrapped chainmail, with a tattered cloak of autumn leaves and a massive stag skull fused to her own. Her breath fogs unnaturally warm even in the chill air.

additions.title: Athach
additions.note: Elven noble so enraged with his former lover that he convinced the Wild Hunt to kill her.

additions.title: Robbing a drunk
additions.note: Lysander recognized Athach from the locket and decided to investigate him as subtly as he could. Athach was uninterested in talking to anyone wanting only to sulk. Stumpy challenged him to a drinking contest and won the mans most valuable possession: A name written on a piece of paper. Athach laughed as they took it mentioning how the name would get them killed. Lysander then robbed him finding several gems worth nearly a thousand gold, the most by far that Lysander had ever stolen. He also found a key with the name Orin engraved in it.

additions.title: Interesting Friends
additions.note: Lysander made friends with Harkon and secured a promise of a future meeting.

additions.title: Successfull Hunt
additions.note: The boar was killed and delivered to Dala

additions.title: Severus
additions.note: True elf guest at the feast, distant relative of Princess Dala. Foppish, rich, arrogant, and deeply insecure

additions.title: Third Task
additions.note: Getting the boar in time for the feast Dala tasks the party to attend so that she may show you off to her guests. The party manages to acquire a false bottomed chalice, steal a ring from a rude noble, and fingerbang a drunk chick.

additions.title: Fourth Task
additions.note: The party is asked to help a hopeless Satyr find love.

additions.title: Petey
additions.note: Sentient ring gifted to Lysander in the fey wilds. Has dimensional storage and might have other unknown abilities

additions.title: Shopping
additions.note: Olga manages to get an axe crafted using the axe blade stolen from Lydia. Stumpy purchases a set of armbands with the name Narn on it trading away his knowledge of a skill. Lysander buys some thieving equipment and convinces the shopkeeper to help him out. Since the shop keeper also hates Severus she gifts Lysander a ring with the name Petey scrawled on it.

additions.title: Getting a Goat Laid
additions.note: Trying to get Beau laid proves nearly impossible, and the party decides to give up looking. Instead Olga decides to sleep with him and hope Dala will accept that as a success

additions.title: Kael
additions.note: Adventurer, early 30s, barbarian

additions.title: Theron Ashfeld
additions.note: (missing) 3/4 wood elf, 1/4 orc, ranger/druid, Silovan's agent who is helping search for his employeers

additions.title: Sable
additions.note: (missing) Theron's lynx companion, dark gray with silver tips

additions.title: Lady Selara Hawthorne
additions.note: (missing) Duchess of Ironford region, lives in Sorinsk, brother is sick with lycanthropy. Kidnapped by Vrakka's Hand

additions.title: Lord Varen Hawthorne
additions.note: (missing) Brother of Selara Hawthorne, sick with lycanthropy. Kidnapped by Vrakka's Hand

additions.title: Silovan Kreshholm
additions.note: (missing) Wood elf, Lady Hawthorne's intelligence agent, hired the party. Kidnapped by Vrakka's Hand

additions.title: Aleks Ashfeld
additions.note: (missing) ~50 years old – Petey’s older brother. The 'good son' who worked honest jobs and tried to keep Petey out of trouble. Now a weathered dockworker, still maintaining his integrity despite a hard life

additions.title: Varen
additions.note: (missing) Kael's companion, female rogue, understands Thieves' Cant, spoke with Lysander, open to partnership with Olga. Kidnapped by Vrakka's Hand

additions.title: Lev 'The Moth' Rybar
additions.note: Drug dealer, late 30s, paranoid but reliable, operates after dark

additions.title: Vrakka Bloodfang
additions.note: Half orc slaver, leader of Vrakka's hand

additions.title: Return to Ashwood
additions.note: The players find themselves back in Ashwood in the Stumbling Stag. 43 have passed

additions.title: Mayor Tamsin Holt
additions.note: A wiry woman in her 60s with a perpetually worried expression and a sharp tongue. She's practical, skeptical of adventurers, but too desperate to turn down help.

additions.title: Mayor Tamsin Holt
additions.note: “Gerrick Bain hasn’t come into town in three days, and now his neighbors say his farm’s gone silent. Chickens, cows—everything’s gone. I’ll give you twenty gold to take a look and come back with something useful.”

additions.title: Investigation
additions.note: Gerrick's house was empty, but no sign of a fight. It appeared all of his animals were led away

additions.title: Cultist
additions.note: Following the tracks they found two cultists complaining about wanting to kill 'that bitch'. The party quickly killed one and subdued the other only to find out they were complaining about carrying water for a cow who was the 'bitch' they were complaining about. Lysander decided they needed to kill them to avoid reprisals even though it appeared they were innocent.

additions.title: Sha’tin Cult Cave
additions.note: Following the tracks further they found a cave and took out the two guards, then disguised their voices and appearance (using magic) as the cultists. They tried to lure people to come out and be ambushed but the lead cultist was busy completing his ritual. He got annoyed with stumpy and used a spell to crush stumpies heart, then enthralled everyone forcing them to watch as he completed his ritual. Olga, enhanced by her legwraps, overcame the compulsion and killed him. Watching him twitching on the ground Olga felt compelled to finish him and watched as the axe drank up his essence. The other cultists were slaughtered.

additions.title: Return of the Locket
additions.note: Alric's locket, taken from the party before being sent to the fey wilds was found on one of the cultists. Unsure if they should take it the decision was made for them when it magically disappeared, only to be found later inside Lysander's backpack.

additions.title: Information Learned about Sha’tin
additions.note:
Title: The Whisper in Chains
Domain: Devils, obedience, corruption of the will.
Symbols: A broken manacle with its ends curled inward like fangs.

additions.title: Notable Loot
additions.note: A ceremonial dagger of blood drinking (Casts cure light wounds on self after sacrificing a creature. Effect destroys victims soul preventing reincarnation or afterlife)

additions.title: A Useful Introduction
additions.note:
After arriving back in town the mayor informed you that she is writing to the dutchess of Ironford to tell her of your deeds. A week later a letter arrived which disappeared before it could be read. Guessing it was an invitation by Lady Hawthorne was easy enough and the party decided to head out. When the later was later found it read as follows:

To Lysander, Olga, and Stephen,
Your recent deeds in Ashwood have not gone unnoticed. Word of your courage, resourcefulness, and success in protecting the townsfolk from grave danger has reached my attention, and I wish to extend my personal gratitude.
You are cordially invited to my estate for a feast in your honor. It is my hope to meet you in person, hear of your adventures, and discuss opportunities for further service in these lands.
Your presence will be most welcome, and arrangements will be made to ensure your comfort during your stay.
With respect and anticipation,
Lady Selara Hawthorne
Duchess of Ironford

additions.title: Bandits Mysteriously Charmed
additions.note: Some bandits overturned a cart feigning a need for help. They demanded a toll to pass but suddenly changed their turn once their leader fell under a charm effect. It unclear how this happened but was clear that the effect originated with Olga. There was also a few instances of items disappearing

additions.title: Rumors of Vrakka's Hand
additions.note: A group of angry coal burners is met and pacified with offers of alcohol and drugs. They speak about a band of raiders that sack towns carting away it's residents harassing towns. A name of a drug dealer local to Sorinks is shared

additions.title: Lev "The Moth" Rybar
additions.note:
Drug dealer in Sorinks
    • Thin, wiry build, always looks slightly underfed 
    • Pale skin, dark circles under his eyes 
    • Keeps his dark hair slicked back with too much oil 
    • Wears a faded gray coat with many pockets 
    • Nervous energy - constantly moving, twitching, fidgeting 
    • Has a habit of rubbing his fingers together

additions.title: Petey
additions.note: Lysander decides to try to communicate with their thief stalker by simply talking out loud hoping he will hear them. Wooden blocks with letters are created and left out with the intention of allowing their 'friend' to pick up letters to form words. It is soon learned that Lysander has a telepathic link to his ring which has been 'borrowing' his stuff.

additions.title: A Botched Bribe
additions.note:
Entering town Petey recognized the guard and told Lysander to bribe him. The guard insulted by this became angry and demanded to search the parties possessions. Petey continued to insist the guard's name was Ruslan even after it became clear his name was Tavik. 
Stumpy, wearing Alric's amulet, allows the female guard to look inside watching her reation carefully. She indicates her attraction to the man pictured inside mistakenly assuming he was Stumpy's lover.
The party is allowed inside

additions.title: Varen
additions.note: Kael's companion, rogue. Understands Thieves' Cant, spoke with Lysander, open to partnership with Olga.

additions.title: The Offended Adventurer
additions.note: In town the party meets Kael and Varen. Kael gets into an argument with Stumpy which ends in  a drinking competition that Stumpy wins. Olga befriends Varen and Varen leads Kael upstairs to sleep off the drink

additions.title: The Party
additions.note: Lady Hawthorne throws a feast and invites adventurers and nobles including Kael and Varen. At the event, Lysander tells embellished story of their adventures - crowd loves it, Kael doesn't. A priest of Shelyn mistakenly believes Lyasander worships his goddess. Party notices Lysander now wearing a Shelyn necklace (wasn't there before). Lysander plays along

additions.title: Silovan Kreshholm
additions.note: Middle age Wood elf. Lean build, moves with absolute silence. Dark green and brown practical clothing that blends. Wears a small pin with Lady Hawthorne's crest. Lady Hawthorne's intelligence agent. Hired the party for a job

additions.title: Discrete Job
additions.note: Silovan Kreshholm approaches you at the party and asks you to perform a job for Lady Hawthorne. He wants the party to acquire rare herbs and return them to the mansion. 2500 gold for the job with 300 gold up front. It is made clear that this job is not to be discussed with anyone.

additions.title: Journey to Volkmar
additions.note: Party traveled to Volkmar over two days. Attacked by wolves en route—Lysander badly injured. Arrived and began investigating Borim's location. Petey stole a Poison of Sleeping Death. Decided to find someone who gossips. Met Tavi Redholm (halfling) and Aeris Silvaren (elf) at a tavern. Tavi was telling an exaggerated story about a wolf "two stories high" he barely escaped. Both directed party northeast—Borim likely lives in a cave. Also learned that Borim often harvests rare herbs found in the northeast

additions.title: Enslaving the Alchemist
additions.note: Party tracked cart tracks near herbs. Led them to Borim's cave. Borim tried to make them leave. Gary (Olga's axe) dominated Borim. Borim gave Lysander a tattoo and created the Crimson Tincture. Two lycanthropes arrived—party killed them. Gave Borim a potion of forgetfulness and made him drink it.

additions.title: Flight from Wolves
additions.note: The party made haste but was run down by a group of large wolves. Turning to fight they realized these were werewolves. Lysander noticed a man watching in the distance and tried to get him to help, but was unsuccessful. The wolves were killed and Olga finished off the Alpha wolf. Killing the Alpha made her axe grow in power.

additions.title: A chance Encounter
additions.note: Theron, exposed by Lysander, introduces himself. It is learned that he was sent to keep the party safe which he took very literally. He did not help in the fight because he believed they would live. He escorted the party back to town.

additions.title: Sacking of Sorinsk
additions.note:
Smoke still rises from several buildings throughout the town - thin gray columns that stain the sky. The town walls show scorch marks and broken sections. The main gate hangs crooked on its hinges.
As you approach, the devastation becomes clearer. The main street is littered with debris - broken furniture, overturned carts, shattered barrels spilling their contents. Windows are smashed. Doors hang open or have been torn from their frames.
A few townspeople move through the wreckage like ghosts, salvaging what they can. They move slowly, mechanically, in shock. Some are bandaged. Others simply stare at nothing.
    • The docks are damaged - pilings broken, debris floating in the water 
    • Several ships are missing from the harbor 
    • Guard posts are abandoned or destroyed 
    • The manor house on the hill shows signs of forced entry 
    • Many buildings are intact but looted 
    • People are alive but traumatized 
Kael and Varen fought the raiders when they hit the tavern. Varen was knocked out and dragged away.
The raiders all had Blue and Orange fish tattoos.

additions.title: Bullying a ride
additions.note: Theron convinces the sole remaining captain to sail you to Elredd and Highport. Kael agrees to join you. The trip will take approximately 5 days. You set sail on the Silver Surgeon with Captain Casimir Rybar. The next full moon is in four days during which time Hawthorne's brother will likely become a lycanthrope.

additions.title: Kraken
additions.note: The day before arriving in Elredd the ship is attacked by a Kraken. A glancing blow from the creature injures Olga but the wounds regenerate much quicker then they should. After eating about a dozen sailors the Kraken retreats into the depths.

additions.title: Desna's Whim
additions.note:
Desna's Whim — d100 Flavor Table
Roll
Flavor
01  Starlight Blind. A burst of silver light in someone's eyes at the critical moment.
02  Wrong Foot. A stone turns, a boot slips, balance falters.
03  Forgotten Word. A crucial syllable, name, or instruction slips the mind.
04  Wind at the Back. A sudden gust pushes exactly the right direction.
05  Sudden Memory. A relevant recollection surfaces at the perfect instant.
06  Loose Buckle. A strap, clasp, or fastening chooses now to fail.
07  Butterfly Effect. A small creature crosses the path — distraction or omen.
08  Borrowed Grace. Movements become briefly, uncannily elegant.
09  Echoing Doubt. A whispered second-guess in the mind's ear.
10  Lucky Thread. A loose thread catches on something useful — or damning.
11  The Coin Flips. Something small and metallic rings on stone nearby.
12  Stitch in Time. A half-second hesitation changes everything.
13  Shadow Puppet. A shadow moves wrong, drawing the eye.
14  Familiar Face. Someone looks momentarily like someone else — friend or foe.
15  Dust Devil. A small swirl of dust, leaves, or snow at the key moment.
16  Slip of the Tongue. Wrong word said, right word heard, or vice versa.
17  Heart's Beat. A single thunderous heartbeat drowns out all else briefly.
18  Cold Spot. A patch of unnatural cold — distraction, warning, or worse.
19  Moonbeam. A shaft of light from nowhere illuminates (or conceals).
20  Sudden Clarity. The world sharpens for one perfect second.

24  Déjà Vu. A moment feels rehearsed, granting or stealing confidence.

32  Old Wound. A past pain flares — distraction, motivation, or both.
33  Wrong Hand. An off-hand action is attempted, for better or worse.
34  Lantern Flicker. A nearby light source gutters, flares, or changes color.

36  Snake's Tongue. Words twist on the way out — truth told as lie, lie as truth.
37  Thread of Fate. Something feels pre-ordained, for one beat.
38  Bird's Eye. A momentary sense of the whole battlefield/scene from above.
39  Gentle Touch. An unseen hand guides a blade, finger, or word.
40  Sour Note. A wrong sound — a bowstring twang, cracked voice, off-key chant.
41  Pilgrim's Luck. An improbable coincidence stacks in someone's favor.
42  Dust in the Eye. Literal or figurative — vision obscured at the crux.
43  Stargazer's Trance. A half-second of distraction by something beautiful.
44  The Road Rises. Ground shifts subtly — easier or harder footing.
45  Echo Chamber. Words or sounds repeat uncannily, carrying new meaning.
46  Fool's Gold. Something glitters that shouldn't, drawing attention.
47  Sigil Awakens. A tattoo, mark, or sign on someone warms or glows.
48  Half-Remembered Song. A tune surfaces — comforting, distracting, prophetic.

50  Night's Mercy. Darkness thickens briefly, hiding or revealing.
51  Hummingbird Heart. Time stretches — one second becomes three.
52  Clean Miss. An action that should have connected passes through empty air.
53  Seamstress's Blessing. A tear mends, a gap closes, a wound staunches briefly.
54  The Wanderer Smiles. Luck turns, visibly, for someone in the scene.
55  Lost and Found. Something missing is suddenly at hand.
56  Compass Spin. Direction becomes briefly uncertain — or perfectly clear.
57  Moth to Flame. Attention is drawn irresistibly toward one point.
58  Traveler's Boon. A small useful item appears in a pocket or pouch.
59  Whispered Name. Someone's true name is almost-heard on the wind.
60  Starlit Step. A footstep lands perfectly, gracefully, impossibly.
61  Silver Tongue. The next words out of someone's mouth are unusually persuasive.
62  Crossroad. A choice presents itself that wasn't there before.
63  Borrowed Breath. Exertion comes easier, or harder, for one moment.
64  Night Bloom. Something beautiful happens at the wrong time.
65  Dream Logic. The scene briefly obeys dream-rules instead of waking ones.
66  Fell Swoop. A single decisive motion carries more weight than it should.
67  Passing Stranger. An NPC intervenes briefly — helpful, hindering, or just odd.
68  Ink Runs. Writing, runes, or markings smear, shift, or rewrite themselves.
69  Good Dog. An animal (real or imagined) aids, warns, or distracts.
70  Thief's Luck. Something valuable changes hands unnoticed.
71  Clear Head. Fear, rage, or confusion lifts — or descends — suddenly.
72  Hinge Creaks. A door, gate, or lid moves on its own at a meaningful moment.
73  Skipped Stone. An action ricochets, skips, or glances in an unexpected way.
74  Soft Spot. A weakness is suddenly apparent — armor gap, tell, insecurity.
75  Sunbeam. Warmth and light in an unexpected place — comforting or blinding.
76  Butterfly's Kiss. A touch so light it's almost not there, but everything changes.
77  Cup Runneth Over. A resource (ammo, spell slot, stamina) feels renewed briefly.

79  Hawk's Cry. A sharp sound from above cuts through the moment.
